name: compare_climate_scenarios
description: Compare the same climate variable, region, and period across multiple climate scenarios. The function can either load registered climate layers internally or compare already-loaded climate layer artifacts.

variable.description: Climate or hazard variable to compare. Examples: 'extreme_heat_days', 'tasmax', 'heat_index'. Required if climate_artifacts are not provided.

region_name.description: Region name for the comparison. Examples: 'Fiji', 'Tonga', 'Melanesia'. Required if climate_artifacts are not provided.

period.description: Projection period to compare. Examples: '2050s', '2060s', '2100s'. Required if climate_artifacts are not provided.

scenarios.description: Climate scenarios to compare. Examples: ['SSP2-4.5', 'SSP5-8.5'] or ['ssp245', 'ssp585']. Required if climate_artifacts are not provided.

climate_artifacts.description: Optional already-loaded climate layer artifacts, one per scenario.

value_column.description: Optional numeric column to compare. If omitted, the function uses the value_column metadata from the input artifacts.

return_geometry_format.description: Geometry output format. Currently only GeoJSON is supported.

period.description: Projection period used for the scenario comparison.

geojson.description: GeoJSON FeatureCollection containing the scenario comparison layer.

bbox.description: Bounding box as [minx, miny, maxx, maxy].

comparison_columns.description: Names of scenario-specific value columns, scenario min/max/mean/range columns, and highest/lowest scenario columns.

summary.description: Summary statistics for the scenario comparison.

provenance.description: Information about parent scenario layers and comparison method.
